rubric.direct_usefulness: Exact places, useful activity details and decisions; reject filler and generic town lists.
rubric.geography: Exact town and coherent nearby route; no unsupported distance or driving time; check endpoints.
rubric.evidence: Primary source supports the actual claim; retrieval date is not publication date or proof of current access.
rubric.activity_fit: Trail metrics and direction; tent capacity and child admission; real natural setting for dining; current official hunting season.
rubric.consistency: Compare repeated identical question for factual contradictions and unexplained destination changes, not literal wording.
rubric.honesty: An honest limitation is safer than invention but does not automatically pass usefulness.
rubric.languages: Review Arabic, English and French for equivalent factual quality.
